meta.privacy_class: INTERNAL-ONLY SCHEMA. This file contains a lease-abstract *schema*, not lease data. Every substantive field is empty by design and must be filled by a named authorised adviser working from the executed documents, never from this public repository.

placeholder_key.[LEASE-FILE]: executed ground/space lease - offline, authorised advisers only
placeholder_key.[TAX-RETURNS]: owner tax returns - offline, never in this repo

property.value: Single-tenant quick-service restaurant on a ground lease
property.note: The brief states a NNN lease. Whether the interest is a ground lease (owner owns land, tenant owns box) or a building lease materially changes the exit. Not verified.

Tenant corporate credit verified; the specific franchisee/operating entity behind this unit is NOT verified. In a franchise system the credit may be the franchisee, not the brand. This is the single most important credit question and it is currently unanswered.
Required for parcel-level hazard, tract and planning lookups. Not published.
No official definition of 'Central LA' applies to a parcel. Trade-area definition remains open (W-01).
Drives seismic code vintage, roof/equipment reserve and remaining economic life. To resolve: [SITE-PLAN] and building records.
Drive-thru share of QSR sales is decisive for site value; a box without a functioning drive-thru re-lets at a materially different rent. To resolve: [SITE-PLAN].

lease_abstract.note: The brief gives a five-year window, not a date. Every projection in this repo is therefore run as a range. FLAG I-02.

lease_abstract.formula: expiration date minus 2026-11-25, once the date is known
lease_abstract.note: Cannot be computed from a range without inventing a date.
The central missing number. Neither the sale case nor the hold case can be priced without it.
Fixed bumps vs CPI-indexed changes the present value materially. Compare any fixed bump against the verified 3.79%/yr LA CPI-U CAGR (PI-04).
An option held by the tenant is a call the owner has written; it caps upside and is priced by buyers.
Fair-market-value vs fixed vs CPI. The single largest driver of the renewal case.
If the tenant may go dark and still pay, the rent stream is closer to an unsecured bond. If not, a closure creates a live lease with no operator.
Franchisee personal guaranty vs brand corporate guaranty is the difference between investment grade and speculative credit.

Confirm the tenant bears property tax, insurance and structural repairs. Verify the exclusions - roof, structure, parking lot and HVAC are commonly carved back to the landlord and are the real cost of a 'NNN' lease.
Required to build the notice calendar (R-03).
A tenant termination right inside the 2030-2035 window would be a material defect in the income stream.

notice_calendar.note: Until the expiration date and notice period are known, no calendar date can be produced. Producing one would be a fabrication.

notice_calendar.item: First date the owner may market the property without triggering tenant rights

reconciliation_notes: R-03 requires the lease abstract to be reconciled against the notice calendar BEFORE any sale or renewal commitment is made. That reconciliation is represented here as a schema with an empty calendar. It cannot be executed without [LEASE-FILE].

The correct sequencing is: abstract the lease -> build the calendar -> confirm every dated obligation -> only then authorise a broker to market or a letter of intent to be signed. Skipping the calendar is how owners lose a renewal option by a few days.
